scripts.build: npm run frontend:build && mkdir -p dist && go build -tags embed_frontend -trimpath -o dist/materialmind ./cmd/materialmind
scripts.test:embedded: npm run frontend:build && go test -tags embed_frontend ./...
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run vet && npm test && npm run test:embedded && npm run build
scripts.format: gofumpt -w cmd internal && npm --prefix web exec -- prettier --write --ignore-path web/.prettierignore web
scripts.format:check: test -z "$(gofumpt -d cmd internal)" && npm --prefix web exec -- prettier --check --ignore-path web/.prettierignore web
